about.text: Cheese that keeps much of its water, more than 67 % in the cheese without its fat under German cheese law, so that it stays soft and, as it ripens from the outside in, turns creamy. In Germany called Weichkäse; the bloomy and washed rinds are soft cheeses taken further.

picks.why: Lombardy's PDO stracchino-style soft cheese, a defining fresh-ripened cow's cheese of northern Italy.
